messages:
Marc A: Heads-up — I'm scheduling a staggered rollout to tune autoscale for dedicated GPU pool 'slice-7' at 2026-03-20 15:30 UTC. Small param tweak: scale_down_threshold 0.15 -> 0.12. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/942 :eyes:
Sara L: LGTM from perf. Did you run sims against our traffic shape?
Marc A: Yep — ran 10k QPS mixed load. Median latency ~unchanged, p95 +2ms, cost per-token down ~3% in the sims. No cache regressions.
Devon S: I'll be on-call for the window and watch routing/evictions. Share the smoke checklist and rollback commands please.
Marc A: Smoke checklist (will run each step during canary):
```
1) check /health on canary hosts -> 200
2) run 3 representative inference prompts (short, mid, long)
3) confirm KV cache hit-rate stable (console)
4) verify batch sizes haven't regressed (>95th percentile)
5) confirm model-serving pods CPU/GPU utilization nominal
```
Priya K: I'll handle the sample inference runs and validate outputs for qualitative drift. Will post diffs if anything looks off.
deploy-bot: infra-deploy job started: job_id=deploy-1790456789, targeting pool=slice-7, strategy=staggered.
Marc A: Rollout plan: 10% -> 30% -> 100% with 20m observation windows. Abort conditions: >5% increase in error rate, >100ms p75 latency delta, or cache miss spike >10%.
Sara L: Adding temporary dashboards and alerts for p50/p95/p99, error-rate, and cache hit-rate.
Devon S: I'll monitor alerts and tracing. If anything trips, ping @Devon S and I'll initiate rollback.
Priya K: Rollback command (infra CLI):
```
infractl rollout cancel --pool slice-7 --target-version previous --reason "autoscale tweak rollback"
# follow-up: infractl status --pool slice-7 to confirm state
```
Marc A: If we need to revert manually: kubectl -n infra rollout undo deployment/dedicated-slice-7 --to-revision=<prev> ; but prefer infractl path. I'll be online for the whole window.
Sara L: :thumbsup: I'll stand by for metrics and can help triage.
Devon S: On-call noted in calendar. Watching logs and SLOs.
Marc A: Thanks all — will post canary results after each phase. If no objections, starting at scheduled time. :rocket:
